headline: Lex Consult, JSA act on Supply6 Series A fundraise
sum: Kanari Nutrition Private Limited, dba Supply6, has raised capital from a Series A fundraise led by Unilever Ventures, with participation from Zeropearl VC. Lex Consult advised Supply6 on this fundraise.
detail: Kanari Nutrition Private Limited, dba Supply6, has raised capital from a Series A fundraise led by Unilever Ventures, with participation from Zeropearl VC. Lex Consult advised Supply6 on this fundraise. The transaction was led by Naresh Pareek (Partner), with assistance from Riya Trivedi (Senior Associate) and Vibhor Jain (Associate). Naresh Pareek JSA Advocates & Solicitors advised lead investor Unilever Ventures on this fundraise.
